business: Coast, an AI content workspace for social media agencies
by_segment: Owner or lead at a 6-10 person agency, 20+ clients
Owner of a 2-5 person agency, 8-20 clients
by_behaviour: Already uses ChatGPT or Claude daily
why_not: I already pay for my scheduler and Planable-type tools do the approval bit, so this is another subscription on top. The CSV export is nice but it's one more step in a Monday routine that already works.

I already get captions from ChatGPT with a saved brief per client and I'm not going to rebuild 12 client voices in a new tool for something I mostly get already. The approval link is nice, but my clients already approve over WhatsApp and I'd rather not add another thing to my Monday.

AI captions still sound generic and I end up rewriting them, and 5 to 10 pasted posts doesn't convince me it'll nail 20+ different voices. I'd maybe poke at the free trial, but I wouldn't pay until it proved it saves me real time.

I'd probably sign up for the free trial because it's no card, but I doubt I'd pay after. Every AI tool says it learns the voice and the captions still come out generic, and I end up rewriting them anyway.

I already pay about 20 a month for ChatGPT/Claude with a project per client, and it works. This looks like a side project, and I would not move 20+ client voices, half of them in Lithuanian, onto a tool I cannot judge in a normal week.

I run everything through my scheduler and my clients approve over WhatsApp already, so a new tool holding 20+ clients' brand voice and posts from a founder I've never heard of is a hard sell. The CSV export is nice but I'm not swapping my approval flow for it on a trial.

I already pay for a scheduler and Canva, and this doesn't publish or do approvals inside my scheduler, so it's one more tab and one more subscription I'd have to justify every month. The CSV export and approval link are nice, but I can't see it getting used weekly across 20+ clients.
